entries.title: add a per-app mode that locks only the selected activities
entries.description: An app's activity list can now be flipped so only the checked activities ask for the unlock prompt.

entries.title: skip redirect when a recents launch already has a posted auth
entries.description: Reopening a locked app from recents no longer stacks a second unlock prompt behind the one already on screen.

entries.title: validate token package before consuming a pending unlock
entries.description: Unlocking an app from recents no longer asks for a second authentication right after the first one succeeds.

entries.title: start the unlock prompt on first window focus
entries.description: The unlock prompt no longer cancels itself the moment a locked app launches, which sent you home before you could authenticate.

entries.title: apply setting changes without a reboot on all Xposed builds
entries.description: Changes to the locked app list and other settings now take effect immediately on Xposed builds where they previously applied only after a reboot.

entries.title: use primary elevated card for active status
set unlock methods for a single app
entries.description: An app can now use its own biometric and screen lock choice instead of the global one.

entries.title: choose which biometrics and screen lock unlock apps
entries.description: The unlock prompt and the app's own settings lock now offer face unlock where it counts as a weak-class biometric, with an option to require the strongest biometrics or the screen lock instead.

entries.title: label each sensor's biometric class on the dashboard
entries.description: The hardware card now shows whether the fingerprint reader and face unlock are Class 3 or Class 2 on this device instead of one combined label.

entries.title: retry the unlock prompt when it self-cancels on launch
entries.description: Locked apps no longer bounce back to the home screen when the unlock prompt disappears before you can authenticate.

entries.title: add screen lock fallback to self-lock
entries.description: Adds a setting to let the screen lock open the app's own settings when biometrics fail.

entries.title: rebuild nav bar without removed override API
mark reflected methods accessible
entries.description: Locked apps no longer open without authentication on devices where the unlock prompt failed to appear.

entries.title: use surface colors in floating navbar
entries.description: The floating navigation bar now matches the surface colors used elsewhere in the app.
